articles.title: Zcash developers want 20-second blocks just days after major speed upgrade
articles.snippet: Early data shows Zcash's orphan-block rate holding close to pre-upgrade levels despite blocks arriving three times faster, encouraging developers to push for another reduction.

articles.title: Zcash Upgrade Could Lock $16 Million in Crypto Forever
articles.snippet: Zcash's latest upgrade promises faster transactions, but thousands of coins remain in an aging privacy system that will soon stop accepting withdrawals, potentially leaving their owners empty-handed.
